aaron rodgers.note: Back-to-back 21+ fantasy games and a soft Week 5 spot, but weekly volatility makes him a matchup streamer only.

alvin kamara.note: Starts only because Etienne (hamstring) is on IR until Week 9; poor efficiency and Kendre Miller is mixing in behind him.

antonio williams.note: WAS rookie serving as WR2 next to Diggs with McLaurin's hamstring likely sidelining him again: 73.2% route rate, 8 targets, 12.6 expected fantasy points in Week 4 (an 87-yard TD was negated by penalty). Real next-man-up usage, though Mariota at QB is a mild downgrade.

brenton strange.note: 7-of-8 for 95 yards in Week 4, RotoBaller's #2 TE waiver option; role is real but JAX has many mouths to feed and PHI is a tougher Week 5 draw - matchup-based TE2.

brian robinson jr..note: FantasyPros consensus #4 with a growing ATL role; not startable yet, stash for role growth.

c.j. stroud.note: One-week streamer on matchup; not trusted as a season answer.

chris bell.note: MIA garbage offense - excluded by rulebook; a near-miss deep TD doesn't change that.

devaughn vele.note: Unverified role behind NO's top options; no snap/target data found to justify a roster spot.

dohnte meyers.note: Role is real (9 targets, possible CIN WR1 in Week 5) but the talent check says no - Kenny's explicit example of opportunity without talent. Trap.

emanuel wilson.note: Consensus #1 add: 21 carries for 81 yards + 4 catches for 39 yards, 2 TDs in Week 4 with 72 yards after contact and 5 missed tackles (PFF). SEA's starter with Price on IR and Charbonnet (knee) out; Charbonnet's return (Week 6-7 earliest) is the expiry risk.

jacoby brissett.note: 52-attempt volume QB and Detroit is the league's best QB matchup - pure streamer, not a hold.

jakobi meyers.note: 10 catches on 12 targets with a TD over his last two games; starting JAX perimeter WR with real targets and a PPR flex floor.

jameis winston.note: Not the answer at NYG; don't chase a name.

jaylen wright.note: MIA garbage offense - excluded by rulebook.

jordyn tyson.note: IR stash with a possible Week 7-9 return; talented rookie with multi-week runway once active.

keaton mitchell.note: Led the LAC backfield in snaps (38%) and touches (career-high 15) in Week 4, taking work from Hampton; explosive but it's a committee in a struggling 0-4 offense.

kendre miller.note: Could pass Kamara while Etienne is out; deep stash only.

keon coleman.note: 6-of-7 for 116 yards and a TD after DJ Moore (shoulder) re-aggravated his injury; 77.8% route rate with growing trust from Allen. But he's volatile (one catch in Weeks 1 and 3) and the role shrinks if Moore returns.

khalil shakir.note: Steady slot target in Buffalo's high-scoring offense; safer weekly floor than Coleman and independent of Moore's status.

kirk cousins.note: 365 yards vs KC shows real form, but he's a one-week streamer, not a season answer.

malik washington.note: MIA garbage offense - excluded by rulebook despite 33 opportunities.

mike gesicki.note: TD in 3 of 4 games with a clear red-zone role and the lead among CIN TEs in snaps; TE1 stream while Chase (concussion) and Higgins (adductor) are out - value evaporates on their return.

ollie gordon ii.note: MIA garbage offense - excluded by rulebook regardless of touches.

roman wilson.note: TDs in back-to-back weeks hide a 16% target share (4th on PIT); TD-or-bust profile with an extremely low floor.

romeo doubs.note: $80M Patriots deal replacing Diggs; 12 catches for 203 yards and 2 TDs through four weeks in a growing role.

t.j. hockenson.note: FantasyPros consensus #3; 13 catches for 119 yards in Week 4 in an every-down role. Shallow position, premium usage.

tank bigsby.note: Core surgery, placed on IR Monday - out for an extended time.

tre' harris.note: SI calls him a Week 5 must-start: 5.3 targets/game, 16.1 yards per reception, beating Johnston in every efficiency metric, with McConkey (foot) trending toward missing Week 5. Path disappears when McConkey returns - rental, not stash.

tyreek hill.note: Free agent with real KC talks (Rice/Thornton hurt); 32 and coming off a catastrophic knee injury - ceiling stash only, don't chase.

will shipley.note: Barkley (hamstring) is week-to-week and Bigsby is on IR, making Shipley PHI's lone lead back vs JAX in London - but value expires when Barkley returns (projected Week 6-8), so price as a rental.

xavier worthy.note: KC's top available WR with Rice (hamstring, short-term) and Thornton (ankle, long-term) hurt, but on BYE in Week 5 and a Hill signing would compress targets.

zach charbonnet.note: On PUP and practicing; season debut no sooner than Week 6-7. Bench stash only - doesn't dent Emanuel Wilson's Week 5 value.
